latestGate.scope: Historical gate arithmetic only; this is not a score or a fresh promotion authorization.

ledger.access: Read-only disposable byte snapshot; source database never opened by SQLite; no reservations or allocations
ledger.scope: Shared post-migration budget. Legacy evaluations were not globally coordinated. This snapshot does not reserve the next ordinal.

nextTrialPlan.alphaSchedule: alpha_t=(1-confidence)/(t*(t+1)); sum over t>=1 is 1-confidence. The shared ordinal is never reset.

familyScore.definition: Within each opening/source family, average the color-swapped paired candidate game scores (win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0); the independent observation count is families, not games.

promotionGate.intersection: Every required opponent must pass. Alpha is not divided by opponents for this intersection gate.

configured.scope: Clock allotment only: games*225*moveMs summed across lanes, and ceil(games/workers) such game allotments. These are neither measured CPU time, predicted wall time nor hard runtime bounds; engine overshoot, startup, I/O, synchronization and contention are additional.

boundCrossing.scope: Algebraic crossing at the specified observed mean, not a power calculation or a claim that this score will occur.

conditionalPower.scope: Sufficient conservative conditional bound for the statistical full gate, not estimated actual power, a universal strength claim or evidence that the current candidate has the assumed improvement.
conditionalPower.derivation: For each opponent, if its conditional mean is at least 0.5+delta, failure probability <= exp(-2*n*(delta-radius)^2). Sum those failure bounds over opponents. Independence between opponents is unnecessary.
assumptions: Condition on all prior training, selection and evaluation history before fixing the candidate and this plan.
For each opponent, the newly evaluated family scores are independent, in [0,1], and have average conditional mean at least 0.5+delta under the recorded opening distribution and move budget.
Family exclusions and unique family IDs prevent recorded reuse but do not prove these statistical independence or mean assumptions.
Do not adapt the candidate, sample count, controls, clocks, gate or outcome handling after observing these evaluation results.

All planned games must actually complete and existing parity, rules and training-evidence gates must also pass. The power bound concerns only the statistical intersection and does not guarantee those other gates.

source.title: Wassily Hoeffding (1963), Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables
source.application: One-sided bounded independent-observation inequality; the two-control union bound and sample-size inversion above are explicit derivations.

nextSteps: Read the current decision and same-cycle training report first; the older arena result does not describe the current candidate.
Freeze the current dataset and initialization; compare completed validation epochs and selectedBaseline before spending another arena trial. Do not force-export a worse epoch to obtain an adoption.

The time limit stopped training before minEpochs. Test a separate bounded run with enough startup/data preparation and epoch time; reaching minEpochs still does not guarantee validation improvement or promotion.

Preregister one fixed candidate and fresh paired families with the shared nextTrial sample plan, then check resources. Keep the existing gate; do not pool adaptive trials, resize after scores or reset the ledger.

Investigate search/value transmission, data coverage and representation/objective alternatives in separate controlled diagnostics. These stored reports do not establish which mechanism causes the plateau.
interpretation: Scores remain separate for each candidate/trial/control. No pooled significance or strength claim is made across adaptive trials. Stored passed statuses are not independently replayed adoption evidence.
limitations: No new training, gameplay, reservations or model adoption were performed.
Completed summary identities and counts are checked, but original moves are not replayed by this report.
Feature, optimizer, data and search causality remains unknown until controlled comparisons are completed.
